nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; assigned msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending new owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer flow.
Public token symbol string, set to "UBS" in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to "UBS Token" in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total token supply, set to 5000000000 and minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances for every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spend allowances.
Pure helper performing an unsigned addition guarded by require(c >= a).
Pure helper performing an unsigned subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Pure helper performing an unsigned multiplication guarded by a division check.
Pure helper performing an unsigned division guarded by require(b > 0).
Constructor of Owned that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes the two-step ownership transfer after require(msg.sender == newOwner).
UBSToken constructor that initialises metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a destination using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
onlyOwner batch transfer that loops over dests/values calling transfer without checking the returned boolean.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits the from balance, decrements the caller allowance and credits the recipient balance.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets an allowance and then calls the untrusted spender contract receiveApproval(...), enabling arbitrary callback execution.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance accounting and allowance accounting.
Unchecked unsigned addition (c = a + b) evaluated before the require(c >= a) guard.
Unsigned subtraction (c = a - b) that must be preceded by require(b <= a) to avoid underflow.
Unsigned multiplication (c = a * b) guarded only by a division equality check.
Unsigned division (c = a / b) guarded by require(b > 0) to avoid division by zero.
External call into an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes); the callback is re-entrancy prone.
External call to an attacker-controlled token contract: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before staging the new owner.
acceptOwnership gates the ownership change on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with safeSub.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
transferMultiple is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
acceptOwnership reassigns owner = newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner).
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the stored owner address.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the caller check, promotes it to owner and zeroes it.
The UBSToken constructor sets _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
Unsigned subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply can underflow.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer rewrites sender and recipient balances through safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom rewrites balance entries through safeSub and safeAdd.
approve writes the allowance entry.
transferFrom decrements the allowance entry for the caller.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance entry before the external callback.
safeAdd performs the raw uint addition before checking the overflow guard.
safeSub performs the raw uint subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw uint multiplication guarded by a division equality check.
safeDiv performs the raw uint division guarded by require(b > 0).
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the from balance and the caller allowance.
transferMultiple loops calling the internal transfer function and ignores its returned boolean.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval, handing control to attacker code.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary, potentially malicious token contract.
safeAdd parameter a is an operand of the addition.
safeAdd parameter b is an operand of the addition.
safeSub parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction.
safeSub parameter b is the subtrahend of the subtraction.
safeMul parameter a is a factor of the multiplication.
safeMul parameter b is a factor of the multiplication.
safeDiv parameter a is the dividend of the division.
safeDiv parameter b is the divisor of the division.
The _newOwner argument is written into newOwner by the owner-only function.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping lookup.
The to address is the recipient key written in transfer.
The tokens amount feeds the safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
dests provides the recipient list iterated by transferMultiple.
values provides the amounts paired with dests in the transfer loop.
spender indexes the allowance mapping write.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from indexes the debited balance and allowance entries.
to indexes the credited balance entry.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowance lookup.
spender indexes the allowance lookup.
spender is both the allowance key and the address externally called in approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance value and is forwarded into the callback.
data is untrusted calldata forwarded verbatim into receiveApproval.
tokenAddress is the attacker-controlled target of the external call.
tokens is the amount forwarded into the external transfer call.
The addition result is stored in the safeAdd return variable c.
The subtraction result is stored in the safeSub return variable c.
The multiplication result is stored in the safeMul return variable c.
The division result is stored in the safeDiv return variable c.
The loop counter i drives and is incremented by the while loop in transferMultiple.
The balances lookup is stored in the balanceOf return variable.
The allowance lookup is stored in the allowance return variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a exists only as an operand of the guarded addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b exists only as an operand of the guarded addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter a exists only as the minuend of the guarded subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b exists only as the subtrahend of the guarded subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter a exists only as a factor of the guarded multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b exists only as a factor of the guarded multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a exists only as the dividend of the guarded division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b exists only as the divisor of the guarded division inside safeDiv.
_newOwner is written directly into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is used solely to index the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
to is only the recipient key of the balance update performed by transfer.
tokens is only the amount consumed by the balance arithmetic in transfer.
dests is only the recipient array iterated by the transferMultiple loop.
values is only the amount array iterated by the transferMultiple loop.
spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
tokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
from is only the debited balance key used by transferFrom.
to is only the credited balance key used by transferFrom.
tokens is only the amount consumed by the arithmetic in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is the allowance key and the address invoked by the receiveApproval callback.
tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded into the external callback.
data is untrusted calldata passed straight through to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the attacker-controlled target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens is the amount supplied to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Local c only holds the result of the addition performed by safeAdd.
Local c only holds the result of the subtraction performed by safeSub.
Local c only holds the result of the multiplication performed by safeMul.
Local c only holds the result of the division performed by safeDiv.
Local i is only the loop counter controlling the transferMultiple batch loop.
Local balance only holds the mapping value returned by balanceOf.
Local remaining only holds the mapping value returned by allowance.
